meta.name: Avatar: Seven Havens
meta.description: In a world shattered by a devastating cataclysm, a young Earthbender discovers she's the new Avatar after Korra. But in this dangerous era, that title marks her as humanity's destroyer, not its savior. Hunted by both human and spirit enemies, she and her long-lost twin must uncover their mysterious origins and save the Seven Havens before civilization's last strongholds collapse.

videos.title: On the Horizon
videos.overview: During a festival celebrating the demise of the Avatar, one orphan girl struggles to stay hidden until she crosses paths with a dutiful airbender.

videos.title: Into the Storm
videos.overview: When a massive storm hits Ellora, Team Avatar unites to save their home and are confronted by a strange entity.

videos.title: The Order
videos.overview: Being the Avatar is a lot of responsibility! Pavi is overwhelmed and misses her friends. Jae stumbles upon a secret organization and must make a life-altering decision.

videos.title: The Faceless
videos.overview: Team Avatar sets out to find a missing bender, leading them into a dangerous confrontation with a ruthless gang of bandits.

videos.title: The One Left Behind
videos.overview: While Jae and Karthik investigate brewing rumors that actively endanger the girls, Pavi and Nisha sneak into Karthik's office to uncover hidden answers about their parents.

videos.title: Night of the Afflicted
videos.overview: Karthik, Nisha, and Pavi must work together to quell a mass panic among the Afflicted inside the hospital. Meanwhile, Jae is forced to deal with a rising wave of unrest brewing within the Bending Brigade.

videos.title: What Lies Beneath
videos.overview: Pavi, Nisha, and Jae uncover a pre-Cataclysm facility beneath Ellora containing a long-dormant time capsule with ancient secrets.

videos.title: The Envoys (1)
videos.overview: Ellora hosts Envoys from other Havens with hopes to receive aid from their estranged neighbors. Nisha takes a Trial to determine her future as an Avatar, while Pavi looks for clues about her past.

videos.title: The Envoys (2)
videos.overview: When the Haven Envoys are attacked, Nisha reveals herself as the world's protector, the Avatar. Meanwhile, Pavi desperately fights an Anomaly beneath Ellora.

videos.title: Ghosts and Spirits
videos.overview: With Ellora under lockdown, Pavi steals away to the Eastern Outskirts and finally discovers her old home. Meanwhile, out in the Harshlands, Nisha makes a new spirit friend who leads her to unlock a memory she wishes she could forget.

videos.title: Battle of the Ruins
videos.overview: Pavi and Nisha find shelter with the Faceless, but their future with the bandits is quickly left in doubt. Jae discovers Kayoko's disastrous plan and must reach the girls before it's too late!

videos.title: The Dome
videos.overview: The battle for Ellora begins! Jae frees the White Lotus while Pavi and Nisha work to keep the dangerous Energy Dome from destroying the Haven.

videos.title: The Root Chakra
videos.overview: The fight for Ellora reaches its momentous conclusion, but powerful revelations from the past threaten to tear Pavi and Nisha apart.
